# PuterVision LLC — MCP Research & Development Labs

> Private engineering research laboratory pioneering deterministic state graph storage, perceptual visual caching, and context compression algorithms for AI developer agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architectures.

---

## 🌟 Core Research Focus

- **Deterministic Context Stores**: SQLite-backed state graph memory for AI coding agents to eliminate LLM hallucination in task tracking and audit trails.
- **Perceptual Fast-Path Matching**: Sub-5ms screen state recognition using Hamming distance dHash algorithms to bypass expensive vision LLM calls.
- **Spec-Driven Development (SDD)**: Compiling Markdown PRDs and Gherkin BDD specs into graph execution nodes to verify requirement coverage.
- **Local Multimodal Perception**: Embedded zero-cloud CLIP vision models and LanceDB vector stores for private semantic retrieval.

---

## 🚀 Published Open-Source Projects

### 1. 👁️ Visual Memory MCP (`@putervision/vision-memory-mcp`)
- **Website**: [visionmemorymcp.com](https://visionmemorymcp.com)
- **GitHub Repository**: [github.com/putervision/vision-memory-mcp](https://github.com/putervision/vision-memory-mcp)
- **Description**: Visual perception cache & perceptual hashing server (v0.8.0, 27 Core MCP Tools). Caches webpage, app screenshots, and WebM/MP4 video files locally using dHash, local CLIP vector search, element grounding, and accessibility trees to cut LLM token costs by up to 90%.
- **Key Features**: L1/L2 dHash zero-token fast-path, L3 local CLIP vector search, WebM & MP4 video frame digesting, Dual-MCP evidence packs (`create_evidence_pack`), element grounding & target action prediction, PII redaction, visual spec regression engine, standalone snapshot archives, real-time token metrics.

### 2. 🧠 State Memory MCP (`@putervision/state-memory-mcp`)
- **Website**: [statememorymcp.com](https://statememorymcp.com)
- **GitHub Repository**: [github.com/putervision/state-memory-mcp](https://github.com/putervision/state-memory-mcp)
- **Description**: Zero-infrastructure, deterministic Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing AI agents with persistent SQLite state graph memory for tracking tasks, decisions, blockers, plans, and artifacts.
- **Key Features**: SQLite graph database, 3D WebGL graph visualizer, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), Git branch isolation, decision trail auditing.
